correctness.rationale: Reconstructed the 9 initially tagged color cohorts with sizes capped at two. Independently enumerated all (3^3−1)^3=17,576 signatures, iterating exact tagged states until repetition: exactly 21 nonzero (entry,period) classes, periods 1,3,4, maximum entry 7, four initially period-4 signatures (156 signatures eventually enter period four). All tau=0 period-four signatures have threshold-one shores of size 2 and third shore initially resting; each yields two labelled A/B choices per shore and exactly eight initially primitive-four states, two orbits. All 1..7 shore-size triples satisfy period-four existence iff a=b=2. The capped-class equivalence and size-feasibility stabilization at 7 extend the finite enumeration to every size; F^19=F^7. Note the proof phrase “four and only four period-four signatures” must mean initially periodic; if read as eventual period, it would be false (there are 156). The displayed four and the theorem itself are correct.
